استنجبن (form X)
# اِسْتَنْجَبْنَ (istanjabna) /is.tan.d͡ʒab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَنْجَبَ (istanjaba)
# اُسْتُنْجِبْنَ (ustunjibna) /us.tun.d͡ʒib.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَنْجَبَ (istanjaba)
# اِسْتَنْجِبْنَ (istanjibna) /is.tan.d͡ʒib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَنْجَبَ (istanjaba)
